data_quality.note: 14 of 112 historical constituents have no yfinance price history (delisted or acquired names, plus identifiers yfinance does not resolve — e.g. APY, ARNC, CDAY, DAY, FBHS, HRS, JEC, KSU). They are dropped from both numerator and denominator, which biases breadth toward survivors until a delisted-price source is integrated. Daily n_with_price vs n_constituents lets Step 3 quarantine suspect periods.
